verdict.rationale: Circle documents Agent Wallets that let an AI agent hold funds and transact autonomously within spending policies the developer defines, with customizable spending controls and compliance guardrails [circle-docs-19, circle-docs-6]. Keys are secured by MPC or passkeys, so neither the developer nor the agent handles raw private keys [circle-docs-14]. Wallets can be created programmatically via APIs and the Circle CLI [circle-docs-24, circle-docs-48], and address screening adds a further safety layer [circle-docs-26]. missing for 10: explicit per-agent scoped key/credential model, detailed documentation of specific policy types and limits (e.g., caps, allowlists), independent or hands-on corroboration.
